approved_architecture_decisions: Use the reviewed Git-installed runtime release phase2-promotion-v11-aed3218 at source commit aed321842dcc40147f5c739c7d1778f6752f982b.
Treat the same Linux user and control-plane account as trusted authority; malicious same-user swap-and-restore during recomputation is outside the threat model.
Fail closed for ordinary authority drift, missing or extra files, symlinks, special files, path escape, size drift, mode drift, and content drift.
Allow host network sharing only for registered real provider launches whose immutable protocol declares provider_access.
Inject only credential-free numeric-loopback HTTP proxy URLs into provider launches; remove all proxy variables from canary probes and trusted evaluator execution.
Do not inherit the outer AGENTTEAM_LAUNCHER_SELECTION when direct or full experiment adapters launch their nested runtime.
Persist the experiment run ID, run-manifest digest, target-path digest, and controller reference in scheduler state so operator stop validates against the real ledger.
Derive a controller-only run's initial integration baseline from the frozen taskpack runtime release source commit unless the caller supplies an explicit baseline.

Stage provider-readable repo and role context plus the provider result file inside the independent attempt workspace before sealing the sandbox source authority, while keeping those files outside the business Git diff.
Give the normal worker outbox one scheduler tick of publication priority after observing a provider terminal, then retain bounded terminal-only orphan recovery on the following tick.
Mount only the selected Codex 0.145.0 binary, bounded authentication file, sanitized configuration, required system runtime paths, DNS files, and TLS certificates.
Bind the live protocol to model gpt-5.6-sol, medium reasoning, a 600000-token global budget, a 7200-second wall-time budget, and one in-flight provider invocation.
Run P2-08 before P2-09 and P2-10, and require exact current epoch-bound operator authorization before P2-09 may launch any provider.
Use the preregistered deterministic L1 taskpack only in agentteam_direct mode and keep it unavailable to agentteam_full mode.
Do not automatically merge to main or push; P2-10 may only create the reviewed finalization child commit after accepted live evidence and full verification.
